Vox’s Astead Herndon digs into the SAVE America Act, why the Brennan Center for Justice warns it could block millions from voting, and who could face the biggest hurdles.

The cost of childcare has skyrocketed in recent decades. Even though the stigma of using childcare has dropped, the money alone keeps it out of reach for many parents. But many Democrats are now outright talking about what used to be a radical idea: universal childcare. Vox’s Jonquilyn Hill talks with senior policy correspondent Rachel Booth about the politics of childcare.

author: Vox
description:
What does it mean to have a good life when so much feels wrong?

Subscribe to our channel! http://goo.gl/0bsAjO

In this episode of The Gray Area, guest host Jonquilyn Hill speaks with Vox journalist Rachel Wilkerson Miller about her forthcoming book, The Nice Life. Rachel argues that even when we feel anxious or unsettled, we can build a satisfying life through curiosity, friendship, creativity, and generosity. Jonquilyn and Rachel explore how to find joy in difficult times, take pleasure in ordinary things, and share that pleasure with others.


Guest Host: Jonquilyn Hill, host of Explain It To Me
Guest: Rachel Miller, Vox Senior Even Better & Lifestyle Editor
